app_identity.name: HESHAURA
app_identity.tagline: A Piece of Soul. A Part of Your Aura.
app_identity.brand_ethos: Premium handmade editorial luxury jewellery inspired by artisanal mastery, organic metal forms, and high-level editorial storytelling.
app_identity.target_audience: Connoisseurs of artisanal, investment-grade handmade jewellery seeking personal storytelling and spiritual luxury.

typography.body_font: Plus Jakarta Sans, DM Sans, sans-serif

rules.h1: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl font-serif tracking-tight leading-tight text-[#1C1917]
rules.h2: text-2xl sm:text-3xl lg:text-4xl font-serif tracking-tight text-[#1C1917]

layout_and_spacing.philosophy: Editorial luxury whitespace with 2x-3x standard padding, strict asymmetrical grids, clear optical alignment, and high-density product discovery.

key_sections.description: Top bar featuring 33% OFF FIRST ORDER promo code and express delivery promise in HESHAURA signature orange (#D7602B).
Sticky luxury header with off-white solid background (#F7F1E8), border-b (#E5DCD0), brand logo, mega menu dropdown, search bar trigger, wallet balance widget, bag counter, mobile menu toggle.
Editorial mega menu popping up on hover with categorized links (Rings, Necklaces, Bangles, Heirloom Sets, Fine Gemstones), editorial story teaser, and featured seasonal piece.
Full-screen responsive drawer for mobile navigation, search input, wallet preview badge, category breakdown, customer service links.

Bold editorial hero with main title 'JEWELLERY WITH A SOUL.', subtitle tagline, '33% OFF FIRST ORDER' subtle accent badge, high-res lifestyle portrait, dual CTAs ('Explore Craftsmanship' & 'Shop Bestsellers').
Asymmetric Bento showcase of core collections: 'Solace Rings', 'Kinship Bangles', 'Ethereal Necklaces', 'Aura Earrings', 'Artisanal Heirloom Sets'.
Interactive product showcase with image hover zoom, price display in INR (₹), hand-forged remaining stock indicators, 'Quick View' modal trigger, and 'Add to Bag' button.
Editorial quote block over tactile studio background highlighting the HESHAURA philosophy: 'We don't manufacture. We forge stories, layer by layer, in silver and fire.'
Four-stage interactive or visual ritual breakdown: '01. Hand-wax Moulding', '02. Chased Metal Sculpting', '03. Ethical Stone Setting', '04. Aura Polishing'.
Grid of ethical standards: Recycled 925 Sterling Silver, 18K Solid Gold Accents, Fair-Trade Natural Gemstones, Zero-Waste Artisanal Studio.
Grid of latest hand-forged releases with badging ('New Drop', 'Limited Release') and quick interactive preview.
Interactive HESHAURA Wallet Card simulation showing ₹333 Welcome Credit, referral reward breakdown, and quick apply toggle.
High-impact card highlighting 'Refer a Friend → Earn ₹333 HESHAURA Wallet', with instant copy-link button and reward calculator.
Bespoke gift packaging toggle, custom handwritten note preview box, digital gift card option.
Founder's editorial narrative, artisan workshop photo, commitment to preserving traditional gold-smithing skills.
Clean signup form with instant reward callout: 'Join the Inner Circle & Unlock ₹333 in your Heshaura Wallet'.
Editorial multi-column footer with huge bold serif 'HESHAURA' watermark, currency selector, ethics guarantee, social links, legal info.

testing_and_accessibility.data_testid_convention: kebab-case, role-based, unique for interactive components

instructions_to_main_agent: Build a single-page high-end editorial homepage using React, Tailwind CSS, Lucide icons, Framer Motion, and Sonner toasts.
Enforce the exact color palette: Primary Orange #D7602B, Warm Off-White #F7F1E8, Deep Charcoal #1C1917, Surface Cream #FFFDF9, Sand Border #E5DCD0.
Ensure headings use elegant serif fonts (Playfair Display / Cormorant Garamond style) and body text uses clean sans-serif.

Implement interactive states: Mega menu hover flyout, product Quick View modal, Cart drawer simulation, Wallet balance modal, Copy-to-clipboard toast for Referral link, and Toast feedback for Newsletter subscription.
Ensure all interactive elements have data-testid attributes.
Keep the app fully responsive and mobile-first, ensuring smooth mobile menu navigation.
